Sonia Gandhi Memoir Publication Faces Delay Over Unspecified Issue

The publication of Sonia Gandhi's memoir has encountered an impasse with the publisher, Penguin India. Penguin India stated that the delay is due to "a particular issue" and denied any external pressure influencing the decision. The specific nature of this issue has not been disclosed in the coverage.
